_format.note: Room archetypes. Used by data/layout.json to fill instances. Each archetype defines hiding slots, whether a patient is placed here, item chance, and ambient prose. Specific room instances inherit from archetype and override per-instance.
_format.ambient: Short prose presented when the player is in / looks into this kind of room. May contain corruption markup.

bed.name: your bed
bed.ambient: Your bed. The sheets are tucked the way the staff did them. ~~You~~ The chart says you do not sleep.

ward.name: patient room
ward.ambient: A bedroom. The light is on under the door. The chart on the doorframe has been re-stapled.
ward.ambient_empty: An empty bedroom. The bed is made. The chart says the room is occupied.

corridor.name: hallway
corridor.ambient: The corridor stretches. The lights are on. They flicker once.

junction.name: junction
junction.ambient: Two corridors cross. The signage has been [[8]] over.

supply.name: supply closet
supply.ambient: Shelves of linens, gloves, and paperwork. A small light over the desk.

office.name: staff office
office.ambient: A desk with a half-finished form. A coffee cup that is still warm. ~~No one~~ The staff have left.

records.name: records room
records.ambient: Filing cabinets, ceiling to floor. Most are labelled. **One** is yours.

stairwell.name: stairwell
stairwell.ambient: Concrete steps. The number on the wall has been re-painted. The door above is locked.

dayroom.name: day room
dayroom.ambient: Chairs along the walls. The television is on. It does not show anything.

attending_office.name: the Attending's office
attending_office.ambient: Dark. The desk is covered in files. !!One of them is yours.!! The schedule is pinned to the wall.

exit.name: exit door
exit.ambient: An exterior door. The hallway air is colder here. ~~It is unlocked.~~ It is locked at night.

chapel.name: chapel
chapel.ambient: A small chapel. The pews are empty. The cross above the altar is on backwards.
